units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“此事实甚困难！

en.t: The younger nun answered, "This matter is truly very difficult!

units.source_text: 这僧都的性情，在法师之中也是过分坦率的，定然已将此事毫无保留地说出了。

en.t: That prelate is unusually frank even among monks, and he must already have told everything about it without holding anything back.

units.source_text: 所以即使我要隐瞒，不久就会拆穿。

en.t: So even if I tried to conceal it, the truth would soon come out.

units.source_text: 况且薰大将不是无足轻重的人，岂可欺瞒他呢？”

en.t: Besides, General Kaoru is no person of little importance; how could we deceive him?"

units.source_text: 她着急了，喧吵起来。

en.t: She became anxious and started making a commotion.

units.source_text: 别的尼僧都说：“从来不曾见过这样倔强的人！”

en.t: The other nuns all said, "We have never seen anyone so stubborn!"

units.source_text: 于是在正屋旁边设个帷屏，请小君进入帘内。

en.t: So they set up a curtain screen beside the main room and invited Kogimi inside the blinds.

units.source_text: 这童子虽已闻知姐姐在这里，但因年纪还小，不敢率尔提出。

en.t: Although the boy had already heard that his elder sister was here, he was still young and did not dare to bring it up rashly.

units.source_text: 他说：“还有一封信，务请本人拆阅。

en.t: He said, "There is another letter, and I beg that the person herself open and read it.

units.source_text: 据僧都说，我的姐姐确系在此。

en.t: According to the prelate, my elder sister is certainly here.

units.source_text: 但她何以对我如此冷淡呢？”

en.t: But why is she so cold toward me?"

units.source_text: 说时两眼俯视。

en.t: As he spoke, his eyes were cast downward.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“唉，的确如此，你真是怪可怜的啊！”

en.t: The younger nun answered, "Ah, that is certainly true; you really are a poor thing!"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“可以拆阅这信的人，的确住在这里。

en.t: Then she continued, "The person who can open and read this letter truly does live here.

units.source_text: 但我们旁人，不知道是怎么一回事。

en.t: But we outsiders do not know what this is all about.

units.source_text: 还请你对我们说明。

en.t: Please explain it to us.

units.source_text: 你年纪虽小，但既能担任使者，定然知情。”

en.t: You may be young, but since you can serve as a messenger, you surely know the circumstances."

units.source_text: 小君答道：“你们冷淡我，把我当作外人，叫我说什么话呢？

en.t: Kogimi replied, "You treat me coldly and regard me as an outsider, so what am I supposed to say?

units.source_text: 既被疏远，我也无话可说了。

en.t: Since I have been kept at a distance, I have nothing more to say.

units.source_text: 只是这一封信，必须直接交付。

en.t: Only this letter must be delivered directly.

units.source_text: 务请让我亲手奉呈。”

en.t: Please allow me to present it with my own hands."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧对浮舟说：“这小郎说得甚是有理。

en.t: The younger nun said to Ukifune, "This young boy is speaking with great reason.

units.source_text: 你总不该如此无情。

en.t: You really should not be so heartless.

units.source_text: 这毕竟太忍心了。”

en.t: After all, this is far too cruel."

units.source_text: 她竭力怂恿，把浮舟拉到帷屏旁边。

en.t: She urged her on with all her strength and drew Ukifune over beside the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 浮舟茫茫然地坐在那里，小君隔着帷屏窥看她的模样，分明认得是姐姐，便走近帷屏，将信呈上。

en.t: Ukifune sat there in a daze; Kogimi peered at her through the curtain screen, clearly recognized her as his sister, then went up to the screen and presented the letter.

units.source_text: 说道：“务请快快赐复，我好回去报命。”

en.t: He said, "Please give me a reply quickly, so that I may go back and report my mission fulfilled."

units.source_text: 他怨恨姐姐冷淡，向她催索回信。

en.t: Resenting his sister's coldness, he pressed her for a reply.
